# Sample image attribution

The six tap-to-classify thumbnails in this directory come from
[Open Images V7](https://storage.googleapis.com/openimages/web/index.html)
and are licensed **CC BY 2.0**. They have been centre-cropped and resized
to 200x200 WebP; no other modification was made.

No other image in this project is redistributed — `data/manifests/*.jsonl`
records sources and licences so the training set can be rebuilt without
shipping anyone's photographs.
